Hymenoplasty in Barcelona

Nowadays many women turn to surgery seeking an aesthetic improvement of the intimate area, especially because they are not happy with the appearance of their genitals. This dissatisfaction causes emotional difficulties such as depression, anxiety and loss of self-esteem, and may even interfere with patients' sex lives. There are several procedures to adapt intimate appearance to each patient's expectations, among them himenoplastia, also known as himenorrafia o hymen reconstruction.

The Hymenoplasty in Barcelona is available at Clínica Belba, where we have experts in every type of female intimate surgery who can become great allies in improving your self-esteem and sexuality.

What is hymen reconstruction surgery?

The hymen is regarded as a symbol of virginity, so some women turn to hymen restoration surgery to repair it when it has been torn. During the procedure, this elastic, fibrous membrane that partially covers the vaginal opening is reconstructed.

This tissue usually tears at a woman's first sexual intercourse, although it can also be broken by other causes such as accidents, falls, high-impact athletic training or sudden movements.

The hymen recreation surgery is a very straightforward procedure that can be performed without the need for hospitalisation, and the best part is that recovery time is usually very quick.

When is surgical hymen restoration recommended?

The surgical hymen restoration is an intimate surgery, much requested by women who want to recover the original state of this membrane.

Some of the patients who request reconstructive hymen surgery in Barcelona, are looking for something extra in their sex lives, whether for religious reasons or special situations such as second marriages, wedding anniversary celebrations, or to spice up their relationship as a fantasy that adds a greater degree of intimacy.

Hymenoplasty can be performed at any age, and it is even a procedure that helps, both physically and psychologically, women who have been victims of sexual assault.

Expected results of hymen reconstruction surgery

Thanks to its results, hymenoplasty is highly sought after among female intimate surgeries. As well as restoring the hymen to its original condition, it promotes a satisfying sexual encounter for the couple.

Likewise, on an emotional level, it fosters the woman's security and confidence; she will feel satisfied with the new appearance of her genitals, which leads to a significant increase in self-esteem.

Risks of surgical hymen restoration

As with any surgical intervention, risks and complications can occur with hymenoplasty. However, when pre- and post-operative planning is followed, they are very unlikely to arise.

Possible risks include infection, bleeding, abnormal scarring, and excessive resection. That is why it is vitally important to choose a plastic surgeon with proven experience for this and any other surgery.

Pre-operative stage of hymen reconstruction surgery

Before carrying out a hymenorrhaphy, a pre-operative protocol must be applied, consisting of a series of tests and examinations that determine whether the patient is ready for the procedure.

Consultation before hymen restoration surgery

At the first consultation, the surgeon will review any medical history to rule out contraindications. First, they will examine the genital organs before explaining the reconstructive hymen surgery procedure.

They will then request any tests they consider necessary, including assessments by the internist and the anaesthetist (electrocardiogram, X-rays, blood tests…). At this first meeting, the patient can ask questions about the outcome of the surgery, its duration, recovery time, expectations, first sexual intercourse after surgery, etc.

Pre-operative instructions for surgical hymen reconstruction

In addition to completing the pre-operative tests for female intimate surgery, the patient must follow certain recommendations in the days before the procedure, which include giving up smoking 4 weeks before and for 1 month after hymenoplasty to aid healing.

If you take anti-inflammatory medication or contraceptives, it is advisable to consult your doctor so that they can authorise stopping them at least 15 days before the procedure. The anaesthetist will specify the appropriate fasting hours and the surgeon will instruct you to clean the area with an antiseptic soap a few hours before the surgery.

Hymen reconstruction surgery procedure

Hymen reconstruction is a fairly simple gynaecological surgery. If you are thinking of having it done, keep reading, because we explain the details of the procedure.

Technique to use

The aim of hymenoplasty is the restoration of virginity. This intervention is carried out using two techniques, depending on the size of the hymenal remnants. Large remnants are big enough to be brought together and reconstructed with sutures.

In the case of very small remnants, the surgeon makes minimal incisions in the mucosa lining the vaginal walls and sutures the tissue to reconstruct the hymenal structure. In both cases, absorbable sutures are used.

Anestesia empleada

Surgical hymen restoration is a quick and simple procedure, and is therefore performed under local anaesthesia, with or without sedation. Moreover, it does not require hospitalisation; you can go home the same day.

Intervention duration

As for the duration of the procedure, regardless of the approach, the surgical time is 30 to 60 minutes.

Post-operative stage of hymen restoration surgery

After hymen reconstruction surgery comes the post-operative period, in which the patient must follow the specialist's instructions to look after her health and achieve the desired results.

Recovery time after hymen reconstruction surgery

As it is a minimally invasive gynaecological surgery, recovery is quick and even painless. Once the effect of the anaesthesia has worn off, the patient can return home and should rest for one or two days, avoiding sudden movements.

Six weeks after the procedure, progressive physical training can be resumed. However, it is advisable not to do any sport that could tear the hymen again, such as gymnastics, cycling or horse riding, among others.  

Aftercare following hymenoplasty

The stitches are absorbed 15 days after the procedure. During this period it is very important to maintain strict intimate hygiene, cleaning the genitals with water and a special neutral soap in the morning, at night and after going to the toilet.

Tampons and menstrual cups must not be used during menstruation until the first sexual intercourse, which can take place 6 weeks after the reconstructive surgery.

The best surgeons for hymenoplasty in Barcelona

At Clínica Belba we are a specialist centre offering hymenoplasty and other female intimate surgeries. We have the best technology, service and facilities in order to achieve patient satisfaction, integrating their physical and emotional wellbeing.

The team of professional surgeons, led by Dr. Félix Chavarría and the Dr. Mike Dewever, is responsible for giving the initial diagnosis and then proposing the appropriate treatment according to each patient's aesthetic concern, state of health and habits.

If you want a surgical hymen restoration, do not hesitate to request your appointment; we provide all the assistance you need before, during and after the procedure so that you feel safe and confident.

Frequently Asked Questions:

What is the price of hymenoplasty in Barcelona?

A gynaecological surgery such as hymenoplasty does not have a fixed price; there are various factors that make the costs vary.

The quote takes into account the patient's characteristics, the complexity of the case, the reputation of the centre, anaesthesia, the medical team's fees and surgical supplies. In addition, the price could increase if the patient requires psychological care and consultation.

To be clear about how much hymen reconstruction costs, we advise you to attend a consultation with one of our professionals, who, after examining you, will design a plan tailored to your case and, from there, can prepare a final quote.

What scars does surgical hymen reconstruction leave?

The scar from hymenoplasty is invisible, so there is no way to tell a virgin hymen from a recreated one.

What are the main reasons why some women undergo hymenoplasty?

Many women downplay the importance of the hymen; however, there are situations in which this small membrane represents much more than simple tissue. This is especially so in places where it has social, cultural and even religious significance.

Taking these three contexts into account, women may decide to have hymen recreation surgery for the following reasons: to be a virgin at marriage in order to preserve their honour and dignity, especially those who belong to the Islamic religion.

This treatment can help women who are victims of rape, who, besides having their hymen restored, will also feel some relief from the emotional stress this event has caused. Others choose this procedure in order to offer their “virginity” to a new partner, with the aim of increasing pleasure and satisfying their sexual desires. There can be many reasons, and all of them are valid for each person.

What is a good time for hymen restoration surgery?

The best time to have this procedure is during the first days after menstruation has ended, so that the tissue has more time to heal before the next period arrives.

Another important point is that, in order to plan the surgery, the patient must be in suitable health to avoid any complications, and to find this out the surgeon will carry out whatever pre-operative tests are required.

Is the sensation of virginity recovered after hymen restoration?

After the surgery, self-esteem increases and the patient achieves her goal of recovering her hymen. In fact, it will take the same form as before first sexual intercourse; even the partner will feel resistance, and bleeding may occur during intercourse.

Is it harder to have orgasms after hymen reconstruction surgery?

Hymen reconstruction does not interfere with orgasms. After the restoration of virginity, the prescribed rest must be observed, after which sexual relations can continue without any alteration in sensitivity.

How long do you have to wait to have sexual intercourse after surgical hymen restoration?

After the restoration of virginity, it is recommended to wait 4 to 6 weeks before having sexual intercourse. This is the appropriate time for the healing of the hymen to be completed. Likewise, at post-operative consultations the surgeon will indicate how recovery is progressing.

@graph.name: Dr. Mike Dewever
@graph.description: Inició sus estudios en la Université Libre de Bruxelles y terminó licenciándose en la Universidad de Barcelona y recibiendo el premio extraordinario de licenciatura por sus brillantes resultados académicos. Fue el número 75 del examen MIR, de entre mas de 13.000 participantes. Este logro le permitió realizar su residencia en el Hospital Universitario de Bellvitge. Allí se especializó en cirugía mamaria, plástica y reconstructiva. Al acabar la residencia fue contratado como médico adjunto del servicio de cirugía plástica del mismo Hospital Universitario de Bellvitge. Completó su formación como Cirujano plástico en Barcelona en la Clínica Teknon, y en la Universidad de Columbia, New York. Es autor y co-autor de varias publicaciones nacionales e internacionales. Es miembro de la Secpre y de la SCCP. Sus conocimientos son reconocidos a nivel europeo con el titulo de Fellow of the European Board of Plastic surgery (EBOPRAS 2016). Desde del 2017 se dedica exclusivamente a la cirugía privada, con unos resultados muy exitosos, pues la satisfacción de sus pacientes avala la excelencia de su trabajo. Ha participado en varios curso con el Dr Alfredo Hoyos, leader de la cirugia coroporal a nivel mundial. En cirugia mamaria, es pionero en cirugia mamaria minimamente invasiva, con recuperacion rapida y resutaldos naturales, realizando masterclass sobre su tecnica minimal scar. Ha trabajado durante 4 años en la prestigiosa Clínica Planas, donde ha realizado mas de 600 cirugías, su experiencia acumulada representa mas de 3000 cirugías.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuál es el precio de una Himenoplastia en Barcelona?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Una cirugía ginecológica como la himenoplastia no tiene un precio fijo, existen diversos criterios que hacen que los costes varíen.

Dentro del presupuesto se toman en cuenta las características del paciente, la complejidad del caso, la reputación del centro, anestesia, honorarios del equipo médico e insumos quirúrgicos. Además, el precio podría incrementarse si la paciente requiere atención y consulta psicológica.

Para tener claro cuánto cuesta una reconstrucción del himen, te aconsejamos asistir a una consulta con uno de nuestros profesionales, quien después de examinarte, diseñará un plan ajustado a tu caso y a partir de allí podrá elaborar un presupuesto final.

mainEntity.name: ¿Qué cicatrices deja la reconstrucción quirúrgica del himen?

acceptedAnswer.text: La cicatriz de la himenoplastia es invisible, por esta razón no hay manera de diferenciar un himen virgen de un himen recreado.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuáles son las razones principales por las que algunas mujeres se practican a una himenoplastia?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Muchas mujeres le restan importancia al himen, sin embargo, existen situaciones en la que esta pequeña membrana representa mucho más que un simple tejido. Sobre todo, en lugares en donde tiene un significado social, cultural y hasta religioso.

Tomando en cuenta estos tres contextos, las mujeres pueden decidir hacerse una cirugía de recreación del himen por las siguientes razones: llegar virgen al matrimonio para conservar su honor y dignidad, especialmente aquellas que pertenecen a la religión islámica.

Este tratamiento puede ayudar a mujeres víctimas de violación, que además de restaurar su himen, también sentirán algo de alivio al estrés emocional que ha causado este acontecimiento. Otras deciden optar por esta intervención para ofrecer su “virginidad” a una nueva pareja, con el objetivo de aumentar el placer y satisfacer sus deseos sexuales. Las razones pueden ser muchas y todas son válidas para cada persona.

mainEntity.name: ¿Qué momento es bueno para una cirugía de restauración del himen?

acceptedAnswer.text:
El mejor momento para realizar esta intervención es durante los primeros días después de que se haya terminado la menstruación, así el tejido tendrá más tiempo para cicatrizar antes de que venga el próximo período.

Otro punto importante es que, para planificar la cirugía, la paciente debe tener las condiciones de salud idóneas para evitar cualquier complicación y para saberlo, el cirujano aplicará los exámenes preoperatorios que se requieran.

mainEntity.name: ¿Se recupera la sensación de virginidad luego de una restauración del himen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tras la cirugía, ocurre un aumento de la autoestima, la paciente logra el objetivo de recuperar su himen. De hecho, este tomará la misma forma que antes de la primera relación sexual, incluso la pareja sentirá resistencia y se podría presentar el sangrado durante el coito.

mainEntity.name: ¿Se dificulta tener orgasmos luego de una operación de reconstrucción del himen?

acceptedAnswer.text: La reconstrucción del himen no interfiere con los orgasmos, después del restablecimiento de la virginidad se debe cumplir con el reposo indicado, luego se podrán continuar las relaciones sexuales sin ningún tipo de alteraciones en la sensibilidad.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuánto tiempo hay que esperar para tener relaciones sexuales, luego de una restauración quirúrgica del himen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Posterior al restablecimiento de la virginidad, se recomienda esperar de 4 a 6 semanas para tener relaciones sexuales. Este es el tiempo adecuado para que se complete la cicatrización del himen. De igual forma, en las consultas post operatorias el cirujano indicará cuáles son los avances de la recuperación.
